feed.subtitle: New versions of 4DSTEM Studio, Electron Microscopy Studio and the Swift kits they are built on.

entry.title: Electron Microscopy Studio 2.6.0
entry.summary:
Simulate electron diffraction, HRTEM, CBED and STEM images, index a spot pattern, and put figures straight into a paper.
New • Index finds the spots of a diffraction pattern and its full crystal orientation. Drag the simulated pattern to tilt it, step through the solutions, flip it, fit the scale. • Phases from the Materials Project or a CIF; a phase you added once works offline, and Save as CIF writes it out. Find Phases ranks them against your pattern and the elements of your EDS map. • Simulation documents: File > New Simulation shows a crystal's diffraction pattern with the crystal beside it. Save it as a small .emsim file and open it again later. • HRTEM, CBED and STEM simulation: a live HRTEM image with defocus, thickness, optics and frozen phonons; convergent-beam patterns with a thickness series and two-beam thickness measurement; STEM images with BF, ABF, ADF and HAADF bands. Place a simulation beside your measured image, or export it as a script. • Diffraction tools: simulated spots over your pattern for any zone axis (with double diffraction), a spots table, a holder tilt planner, powder patterns and precipitate variants. A pattern saved as PNG or JPEG opens too. • Figures and files: Export Figure writes a PDF or SVG with live text; Copy Figure pastes into Keynote; HyperSpy files go out; every export carries a record of the method and settings that made it. • Quick Look for DigitalMicrograph, MRC, Velox and TIA files in the Finder; TIA .ser and .emi files open. • Strain maps from a lattice image, keys to move between rooms, a welcome window with tutorials, a Help menu, and demo data for a spot pattern, silicon and an EELS core loss. • An AI assistant you connect can work every room and open files from a folder you choose. Off by default.
Improved • Diffraction is laid out in steps (Calibrate, Index, Simulate, Tilt Plan, Powder, Thickness); an indexed pattern labels only its strongest spots, so it stays readable. • Toolbar: Simulate for simulations, Export for every room. EBSD Maps shows its results beside the map. • Faster EBSD dictionary indexing and pattern filtering. • Numbers read the same way everywhere, and variants and warnings no longer rely on colour alone.
Fixed • A HyperSpy spectrum saved as .hdf5 opens. • Updating the downloaded app renames it to Electron Microscopy Studio.
Results change in three places: a ring calibration now fits the central background as py4DSTEM does (the Au standard moves by about 0.2 %); the EDS energy axis is refined from 0.6 keV up; and Quantify on a single SEM spectrum gives line intensities only, as eXSpy does.
Requires macOS 26 or later on an Apple silicon Mac.

entry.title: Electron Microscopy Studio 2.1.1
entry.summary:
Electron Microscopy Studio 2.1.1 opens large files in less memory, offers EDS Auto ID's near misses as one-click Adds, and takes its new name.
• Opening a large image shows its stage and time, and Stop cancels it. • DM4 spectrum images open, and a second EELS Align runs, in far less memory. • Better keyboard and VoiceOver use across the rooms. • Export sheets open on the window that asked; File > Open with every window minimised no longer opens an extra empty one.
Results can differ from 2.1.0: an EDS element found by its L line is quantified on its Kα when the spectrum holds it well excited.

entry.title: 4DSTEM Studio 5.4.3
entry.summary:
Version 5.4.3 is a maintenance release.
• The download from mac4dstem.com is now named 4DSTEM Studio, like the App Store version. Settings and recent datasets carry over, and in-app updates keep working; a copy that updates itself keeps its old file name in Applications for now.
